ctkg:domainconcept:5136a9cb0263b94b3f8cd.description: 仅对特定类型输入信号（如斜坡信号）进行补偿，使系统对该类信号的稳态误差为零，但并非对所有信号完全补偿。

ctkg:domainconcept:550f9472042bebc4561cc.label: 扰动信号
ctkg:domainconcept:550f9472042bebc4561cc.description: An unwanted input signal that affects the system output, typically representing external disturbances.

ctkg:domainconcept:5595fefdcc239f5c08444.label: 用于跟踪的前馈控制结构
ctkg:domainconcept:5595fefdcc239f5c08444.description: Block diagram where the reference input R splits into two paths: one through the plant inverse DC gain G^{-1}(0) and another into a summation with the compensator output, then into the plant G(s) to produce output Y.

ctkg:domainconcept:58b32d6f599add0ab7eb8.label: 最小节拍组合校正方法
ctkg:domainconcept:58b32d6f599add0ab7eb8.description: 选择合适的校正网络类型，令校正后系统的闭环传递函数等于标准化闭环传递函数，由此确定校正网络参数，使系统具有最小节拍响应。

ctkg:domainconcept:59abd9632700f1634517f.label: 离散状态空间设计方法

ctkg:domainconcept:5c7d6f5a4ff04bd0326b7.label: 闭环速度控制系统模型
ctkg:domainconcept:5c7d6f5a4ff04bd0326b7.description: Block diagram of a closed-loop speed tachometer control system with disturbance T_d(s).

ctkg:domainconcept:60729cbdf747b39c2ff78.label: 直接z域补偿器设计方法

ctkg:domainconcept:662d2caa390cab7ff89cb.label: 测量噪声衰减
ctkg:domainconcept:662d2caa390cab7ff89cb.description: The ability of a feedback control system to reduce the influence of measurement noise on the tracking error.

ctkg:domainconcept:69b64bbfce9e45828d270.label: 一阶被控对象离散模型

ctkg:domainconcept:6a32bc0cf2176839753ef.label: 误差全补偿条件
ctkg:domainconcept:6a32bc0cf2176839753ef.description: 使系统误差完全为零的前馈补偿装置传递函数应满足的条件，如Gn(s) = -1/G1(s)或Gr(s) = 1/G(s)。

ctkg:domainconcept:6b32986633be2c4347fa6.label: 误差全补偿条件
ctkg:domainconcept:6b32986633be2c4347fa6.description: 当选择前馈补偿器传递函数为被控对象传递函数的倒数时，系统误差传递函数恒为零，实现对所有输入信号的完全补偿。

ctkg:domainconcept:6daaf5095018a332d359e.label: 最小节拍响应
ctkg:domainconcept:6daaf5095018a332d359e.description: 以最小的超调量快速达到并保持在稳态响应允许波动范围内的时间响应，具有最小的上升时间和调节时间，超调量小于2%。

ctkg:domainconcept:72d64287614ba07da65b3.label: 参数变化
ctkg:domainconcept:72d64287614ba07da65b3.description: A change in the plant transfer function G(s) due to environmental factors, aging, or uncertainty in parameter values.

ctkg:domainconcept:75bb9455b7033d0d7856d.label: 扰动信号
ctkg:domainconcept:75bb9455b7033d0d7856d.description: An unwanted input signal that affects the output signal of a control system.

ctkg:domainconcept:785caa007445e7d5d34dc.label: 测速发电机与无源网络组合实现二阶前馈补偿
ctkg:domainconcept:785caa007445e7d5d34dc.description: 采用测速发电机与无源网络的组合线路近似实现 Gr(s) = (λ2 s^2 + λ1 s)/(T s + 1) 的补偿方案。

ctkg:domainconcept:79bb55c4c06d07fd357ec.label: 连续状态空间设计方法

ctkg:domainconcept:7ac1fd3d4d946a6005473.label: 等效系统型别
ctkg:domainconcept:7ac1fd3d4d946a6005473.description: 通过前馈补偿后，复合控制系统等效开环传递函数中积分环节的个数，决定了系统对特定输入信号的稳态误差。

ctkg:domainconcept:7d7b2c2093e1b52795076.label: Curves of constant damping ratio in z-plane (Figure 13.27)

ctkg:domainconcept:7fe6f3265399479fdcf4f.label: 扰动抑制
ctkg:domainconcept:7fe6f3265399479fdcf4f.description: The ability of a feedback control system to reduce the effect of disturbance signals on the output.

ctkg:domainconcept:8d64003bec180e77672bf.description: The transfer function S(s) = 1/(1+L(s)) that characterizes the effect of disturbances and parameter variations on the system output.

ctkg:domainconcept:8f8da4642639723728daa.label: 灵敏度
ctkg:domainconcept:8f8da4642639723728daa.description: The ratio of the fractional change in a transfer function to the fractional change in a plant parameter, used to measure the effect of parameter variations on system performance.

ctkg:domainconcept:90d3e7470077a3db4e292.label: 前置滤波组合校正方法
ctkg:domainconcept:90d3e7470077a3db4e292.description: 在系统输入端串接前置滤波器以消除串联校正网络新增零点的不利影响，改善系统动态性能。

ctkg:domainconcept:96bb25cb179a77a34e6d9.label: 按输入补偿的复合校正
ctkg:domainconcept:96bb25cb179a77a34e6d9.description: 通过前馈补偿装置Gr(s)使系统输出完全复现输入信号，消除误差的复合校正方式。

ctkg:domainconcept:98d0b7bb7be104ca36fe3.label: 反馈代价
ctkg:domainconcept:98d0b7bb7be104ca36fe3.description: The disadvantages or trade-offs incurred when using feedback control, including increased complexity, loss of gain, and introduction of instability.

ctkg:domainconcept:9b4e79193b3701a965711.label: 未建模动态
ctkg:domainconcept:9b4e79193b3701a965711.description: Dynamics of the real process that are not captured in the transfer function model G(s).

ctkg:domainconcept:9dcf197f97b02d753e086.label: 反馈导致的不稳定性
ctkg:domainconcept:9dcf197f97b02d753e086.description: The possibility that a stable open-loop system becomes unstable when feedback is applied.

ctkg:domainconcept:9dd6e45819cbb414472fb.label: 环路增益 L（s）

ctkg:domainconcept:9e92915575b3e20ce84b5.description: 在反馈控制基础上，引入输入或扰动信号的补偿通道，以在不影响系统稳定性的前提下提高控制精度和扰动抑制能力。

ctkg:domainconcept:aed306227c0364d8de049.label: 等效开环传递函数
ctkg:domainconcept:aed306227c0364d8de049.description: 用于分析按输入补偿的复合校正系统误差和稳定性的等效开环传递函数，定义为Gk(s) = Φ(s) / (1 - Φ(s))。

ctkg:domainconcept:b4b55ece4a9aa3709e50f.label: 时域响应参数灵敏度
ctkg:domainconcept:b4b55ece4a9aa3709e50f.description: A measure of how changes in system parameters affect the time-domain response, particularly the step response, of a control system.

ctkg:domainconcept:b57ab6aa6e17654d63b79.label: 扰动抑制分析
ctkg:domainconcept:b57ab6aa6e17654d63b79.description: Method for analyzing the effect of disturbances on a feedback control system by setting R(s)=N(s)=0 and examining the error E(s).

ctkg:domainconcept:b6a5ab67117745c88183d.label: 灵敏度函数
ctkg:domainconcept:b6a5ab67117745c88183d.description: A transfer function defined as S(s) = 1/(1+L(s)), which characterizes the system's response to reference inputs and disturbances.

ctkg:domainconcept:c01b8b723223b776fb795.description: A method that determines the inverse of the DC gain of the plant transfer function model and incorporates it into the controller to eliminate steady-state errors for command inputs and measurable disturbances.

ctkg:domainconcept:c2edca0b60ba1ce87eb78.label: 前馈控制
ctkg:domainconcept:c2edca0b60ba1ce87eb78.description: A control strategy that uses knowledge of the command input or measurable disturbance to compute a control action that anticipates and cancels the effect, often by inverting the plant model's DC gain.

ctkg:domainconcept:c4223390d01343ed903a1.label: 灵敏度分析
ctkg:domainconcept:c4223390d01343ed903a1.description: Method for evaluating the effect of parameter variations on system transfer functions using sensitivity functions.

ctkg:domainconcept:e1ece02aa6e1f0b54de07.label: 按扰动补偿的复合校正

ctkg:domainconcept:f43cea262e16b94cb63c8.description: 一种控制校正方式，通过在系统中引入前馈通路来改善系统性能，包括前置滤波组合校正和最小节拍组合校正。

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:09ff38ebc58.label: 相对稳定性临界段
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:09ff38ebc58.description: The Nyquist stability criterion is defined in terms of the (-1,0) point on the Nyquist plot or the 0-dB, -180° point on the Bode plot. The proximity of the L(jω)-locus to this stability point is a measure of the relative stability of a system.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:0a62ab9c59b.label: 阻尼比与相位裕度近似关系
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:0a62ab9c59b.description: Equation (9.58) is an approximate linear relationship between the damping ratio ζ and the phase margin φ_pm for a second-order system, where ζ=0.01 φ_pm and the phase margin is measured in degrees.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:0aa3a61ec09.label: 增益裕度
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:0aa3a61ec09.description: A measure of relative stability defined as the reciprocal of the gain |L(jω)| at the frequency at which the phase angle reaches -180° (that is, v=0). It is the factor by which the system gain would have to be increased for the L(jω) locus to pass through the u=-1 point.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:13e6b80efef.label: 特征方程表达式
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:13e6b80efef.description: Expression of F(s) as the characteristic equation, where L(s) is the loop transfer function.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:173808b017c.label: 奈奎斯特围线映射方程
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:173808b017c.description: The net number of encirclements N of the origin of the F(s)-plane is Z-P, where Z is the number of zeros and P is the number of poles encircled by the contour.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:20448a001e5.label: 奈奎斯特围线Γ_s
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:20448a001e5.description: A contour Γ_s in the s-plane that encloses the entire right-hand s-plane, used to determine stability via Cauchy's theorem.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:261394f3ebf.label: 奈奎斯特稳定性判据
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:261394f3ebf.description: The Nyquist criterion provides information concerning absolute stability and can be utilized to define and ascertain the relative stability of a system.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:333919c9da5.label: 阻尼比与相位裕度关系式
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:333919c9da5.description: Equation (9.57) provides the relationship between the damping ratio ζ and the phase margin φ_pm for a second-order system with loop transfer function L(s)=ω_n^2/(s(s+2ζω_n)).

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:43343a22abd.label: s 平面到 F(s) 平面的映射
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:43343a22abd.description: A contour or trajectory in one plane mapped or translated into another plane by a relation.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:44ba9f502d6.label: 相位裕度
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:44ba9f502d6.description: A measure of relative stability defined as the phase angle through which the L(jω) locus must be rotated so that the unity magnitude |L(jω)|=1 point will pass through the (-1,0) point in the L(jω) plane. It is equal to the additional phase lag required before the system becomes unstable.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:44ed262ae0d.label: 二阶系统穿越频率方程
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:44ed262ae0d.description: Equation (9.55) sets the magnitude of the frequency response equal to 1 at the crossover frequency ω_c for the second-order system L(jω)=ω_n^2/(jω(jω+2ζω_n)).

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:45e1051693a.label: s平面相对稳定性定义
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:45e1051693a.description: For the s-plane, the relative stability of a system is the property measured by the relative settling time of each root or pair of roots. A system with a shorter settling time is considered relatively more stable.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:4bd63da77b1.label: 奈奎斯特图对称性结论
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:4bd63da77b1.description: The plot of the contour Γ_L for the range -∞<ω<0- will be the complex conjugate of the plot for the range 0+<ω<+∞, and the Nyquist plot of L(s)=G_c(s)G(s) will be symmetrical about the u-axis.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:5589c4e1d82.label: 函数F(s)定义
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:5589c4e1d82.description: The function F(s) defined as 1 plus the loop transfer function L(s).

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:58232e2756f.label: 从伯德图评估增益裕度和相位裕度
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:58232e2756f.description: The gain and phase margins are easily evaluated from the Bode plot. The critical point for stability is u=-1, v=0 in the L(jω)-plane, which is equivalent to a logarithmic magnitude of 0 dB and a phase angle of 180° (or -180°) on the Bode plot.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:58a81da38d3.label: 奈奎斯特稳定判据（一般形式）
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:58a81da38d3.description: A feedback control system is stable if and only if, for the contour Γ_L, the number of counterclockwise encirclements of the (-1,0) point is equal to the number of poles of L(s) with positive real parts.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:5d9c1b06e05.label: 特征方程
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:5d9c1b06e05.description: The equation F(s)=1+L(s)=0, whose zeros determine system stability.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:6007bf2c161.label: 对数幅相图与稳定裕度
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:6007bf2c161.description: The frequency response of a system can be graphically portrayed on the logarithmic-magnitude-phase-angle diagram. For the log-magnitude-phase diagram, the critical stability point is the 0-dB, -180° point, and the gain margin and phase margin can be easily determined and indicated on the diagram.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:77037a83bc2.label: 回路传递函数有理分式
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:77037a83bc2.description: The loop transfer function expressed as a ratio of numerator and denominator polynomials.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:79879a34063.label: 二阶系统闭环极点公式
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:79879a34063.description: The closed-loop roots are s = -ζω_n ± jω_n √(1-ζ^2).

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:81dc5b9c354.label: 相位裕度定义
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:81dc5b9c354.description: An alternative measure of relative stability can be defined in terms of the phase margin between a specific and a system that is marginally stable.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:9d6084e35e7.label: Z = N + P 关系式
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:9d6084e35e7.description: The number of zeros Z of F(s) within the Nyquist contour equals the number of encirclements N of the origin plus the number of poles P of L(s) within the contour.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:a3540280ac5.label: 奈奎斯特围线
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:a3540280ac5.description: A contour Γ_s in the s-plane that encloses the entire right-hand s-plane, used to determine stability via Cauchy's theorem.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:a554a07a9bd.label: 净角增量公式
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:a554a07a9bd.description: The net angle increase of the contour Γ_F in the F(s)-plane is the difference between the total angle due to zeros and the total angle due to poles.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:a88bac284eb.label: 相位裕度定义（临界稳定）
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:a88bac284eb.description: The phase margin is the amount of phase shift of the L(jω) at unity magnitude that will result in a marginally stable system with intersection of the -1+j0 point on the Nyquist plot.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:a8c779f0b9e.label: 保角映射
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:a8c779f0b9e.description: A type of mapping that retains the angles of the s-plane contour on the F(s)-plane.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:ab407319fd4.label: 奈奎斯特图
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:ab407319fd4.description: The contour Γ_F in the F(s)-plane resulting from mapping the Nyquist contour Γ_s through the function F(s).

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:abb6181d642.label: 有理函数F(s)的零极点表达式
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:abb6181d642.description: General expression for a rational function F(s) with a finite number of poles and zeros.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:b119bbd2916.label: 非最小相位系统的特殊处理
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:b119bbd2916.description: It is relatively straightforward to examine the Nyquist plot of a minimum-phase system. Special care is required with a nonminimum-phase system, however, and the complete Nyquist plot should be studied to determine stability.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:b74c44028ff.label: 奈奎斯特稳定性判据（P≠0情况）
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:b74c44028ff.description: A feedback control system is stable if and only if, for the contour Γ_L, the number of counterclockwise encirclements of the (-1,0) point is equal to the number of poles of L(s) with positive real parts.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:b7a3f600a1e.label: 高阶系统近似为二阶主导系统
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:b7a3f600a1e.description: The approximation of a higher-order system by a dominant second-order system is a useful approximation. Equation (9.58) is a suitable approximation for a second-order system and may be used for higher-order systems if we can assume that the transient response of the system is primarily due to a pair

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:bed130b2ad7.label: 奈奎斯特稳定判据 (P=0)
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:bed130b2ad7.description: A feedback system is stable if and only if the contour Γ_L in the L(s)-plane does not encircle the (-1,0) point when the number of poles of L(s) in the right-hand s-plane is zero.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:c5fe9ef29f4.label: 闭环频率响应最大幅值
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:c5fe9ef29f4.description: The maximum magnitude of the closed-loop frequency response, a useful index of performance in the frequency domain.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:c7952e80eb0.label: Z=N+P关系式
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:c7952e80eb0.description: The number of roots (zeros) of 1+L(s) in the right-hand s-plane is represented by Z = N + P.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:c83c2aaa106.label: F(s)的分子分母表达式
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:c83c2aaa106.description: Expression of F(s) in terms of the numerator and denominator of L(s)=N(s)/D(s).

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:c8fc430f715.label: 增益裕度定义
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:c8fc430f715.description: The gain margin is the increase in the system gain when phase = -180° that will result in a marginally stable system with intersection of the -1+j0 point on the Nyquist plot.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:cdb5ed91daf.label: 线性关系近似精度
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:cdb5ed91daf.description: This approximation is reasonably accurate for ζ ≤ 0.7 and is a useful index for correlating the frequency response with the transient performance of a system.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:ce2492854b1.label: L(s)幅值极限性质
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:ce2492854b1.description: The magnitude of L(s)=G_c(s)G(s) as s=r e^{jφ} and r→∞ will normally approach zero or a constant.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:df3026ed57c.label: 相位裕度作为瞬态性能指标
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:df3026ed57c.description: The phase margin is a frequency response measure for indicating the expected transient performance of a system.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:e66fed879e0.label: 柯西辐角原理
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:e66fed879e0.description: If a contour Γ_s in the s-plane encircles Z zeros and P poles of F(s) and does not pass through any poles or zeros of F(s) and the traversal is in the clockwise direction along the contour, the corresponding contour Γ_F in the F(s)-plane encircles the origin of the F(s)-plane N=Z-P times in the cloc

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:f14d26c4604.label: 增益裕度的分贝表达式
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:f14d26c4604.description: Equation (9.47) defines the gain margin in terms of a logarithmic (decibel) measure as 20 log(1/d) = -20 log d dB.

ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:f5e30ef4f60.label: 增益裕度作为相对稳定性度量
ctkg:m3-v1i:canonical-object:f5e30ef4f60.description: As K is decreased below the marginal value, the stability is increased, and the margin between the critical gain K=(τ1+τ2)/(τ1τ2) and a gain K=K2 is a measure of the relative stability.

ctkg:m3-v1i:knowledge-statement:51040f39.label: 关系断言
ctkg:m3-v1i:knowledge-statement:51040f39.description: 已审阅的来源关系断言。

ctkg:m3-v1i:knowledge-statement:af0f314c.label: 关系断言
ctkg:m3-v1i:knowledge-statement:af0f314c.description: 已审阅的来源关系断言。

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:084dd876f3edda.label: 大圆弧映射
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:084dd876f3edda.description: The mapping of the portion of the Nyquist contour from ω=+∞ to ω=-∞ through the function L(s) as r→∞.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:0a35858213453e.label: 二阶系统阻尼比与相位裕度关系图
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:0a35858213453e.description: A line graph showing the relationship between phase margin (in degrees) and damping ratio for a second-order system, including a linear approximation.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:0a41ec8059bfb7.label: u轴交点公式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:0a41ec8059bfb7.description: Equation (9.45) gives the intersection point on the u-axis: u = -K τ_1 τ_2 / (τ_1+τ_2).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:0a57137a67d931.label: 三极点单位反馈系统回路传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:0a57137a67d931.description: The loop transfer function for a unity feedback system with three poles.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:0d8c500309f20c.label: 频率响应表达式（例9.6）
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:0d8c500309f20c.description: Frequency response expression for the open-loop transfer function of Example 9.6.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:1087c3c809efc1.label: 增益裕量计算示例
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:1087c3c809efc1.description: Equation (9.48) gives the gain margin for the example when τ1=τ2=1 and K=K2=0.5: 1/d = [K2 τ1 τ2/(τ1+τ2)]^{-1} = 4.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:11c78ffed1f0f5.label: 相位裕度43°（由伯德图获得）
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:11c78ffed1f0f5.description: The phase angle when the logarithmic magnitude is 0 dB is equal to -137°. Thus, the phase margin is 180°-137°=43°.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:11d6af89c674e4.label: 临界稳定增益值
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:11d6af89c674e4.description: The gain value for which the system with loop transfer function L(s)=K/(s(s+4)^2) is marginally stable.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:17c008e37fb800.label: 实轴交点频率公式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:17c008e37fb800.description: The frequency at which the Nyquist plot of L(s)=K/(s(τ₁s+1)(τ₂s+1)) intersects the real axis is ω=1/√(τ₁τ₂).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:1aff4e8eaafe44.label: 稳定性条件K₁K₂>1
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:1aff4e8eaafe44.description: The system is stable when K1 K2 > 1, as determined by the Nyquist criterion.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:1c78f19b08543b.label: 二阶闭环系统特征方程
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:1c78f19b08543b.description: Equation (9.53) is the characteristic equation for the closed-loop second-order system: s^2 + 2ζω_n s + ω_n^2 = 0.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:24297af986a0da.label: 单位反馈系统开环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:24297af986a0da.description: The loop transfer function for a unity feedback system with a pole at the origin.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:24c358d75c40e7.label: 增益裕度与相位裕度关系图
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:24c358d75c40e7.description: A plot of gain margin versus phase margin for the system with loop transfer function L(s)=K/(s(s+4)^2).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:2703f65788e51e.label: L2 的增益裕度和相位裕度
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:2703f65788e51e.description: The gain margin for L2(jω) is G.M. = 5.7 dB, and the phase margin for L2 is P.M. = 20°. Clearly, the feedback system L2(jω) is relatively less stable than the system L1(jω).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:290f28a009e59c.label: F(s)示例函数
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:290f28a009e59c.description: Example rational function with two zeros and two poles used to illustrate Cauchy's theorem via angle analysis.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:2b85b20e6e4dac.label: 输出表达式（路径因子与余因子形式）
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:2b85b20e6e4dac.description: Expression for the output of the system in terms of path factors and cofactors.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:2c0291d90b39ba.label: 伯德图示例的环路传递函数 L1
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:2c0291d90b39ba.description: Equation (9.50) defines the loop transfer function L(jω)=G_c(jω)G(jω)=1/(jω(jω+1)(0.2jω+1)).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:2ccb5efb2ab848.label: 正虚轴映射
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:2ccb5efb2ab848.description: The mapping of the portion of the Nyquist contour from ω=0+ to ω=+∞ through the function L(jω).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:2e5521e8c2b3e8.label: 增益裕度与增益K关系图
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:2e5521e8c2b3e8.description: A semi-logarithmic plot showing Gain Margin (in dB) as a function of gain K, with a vertical line at K*=128.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:30469be25874e6.label: 右半平面零点数计算
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:30469be25874e6.description: Number of zeros of the system in the right-hand plane, computed from the Nyquist criterion when K1 K2 > 1.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:32d7fd20403b76.label: ω_c²/ω_n² 解
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:32d7fd20403b76.description: Equation solving for ω_c yields ω_c^2/ω_n^2 = (4ζ^4+1)^{1/2} - 2ζ^2.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:32f06fb2949271.label: 交点实部值
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:32f06fb2949271.description: Value of the real part of L(jω) at the intersection point where ω^2 = 1/K2.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:34c6c7ed7c2dac.label: K > 1/2 时系统不稳定
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:34c6c7ed7c2dac.description: The system is unstable for all K > 1/2.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:34f1dff8debc22.label: L(s)=K/(s(τ₁s+1)(τ₂s+1))的稳定条件
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:34f1dff8debc22.description: For the open-loop transfer function L(s)=K/(s(τ₁s+1)(τ₂s+1)), the system is stable when K ≤ (τ₁+τ₂)/(τ₁τ₂).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:36a3fc40343654.label: N=3-1=+2计算示例
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:36a3fc40343654.description: Example calculation of N for a contour enclosing three zeros and one pole, resulting in two clockwise encirclements.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:39ad2889f531c1.label: L(jω)在ω→+∞时的极限
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:39ad2889f531c1.description: Asymptotic behavior of L(jω) as ω approaches +∞.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:3b8c947beae3d2.label: 回路传递函数的频域形式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:3b8c947beae3d2.description: Equation (9.54) is the frequency domain form of Equation (9.52): L(jω) = ω_n^2 / (jω(jω+2ζω_n)).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:3cf80494ea92e0.label: F(s)=s/(s+2)映射示例
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:3cf80494ea92e0.description: A rational function used to map a unit square contour from the s-plane to the F(s)-plane.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:3dce9bc01b0e55.label: 稳定性条件（K ≤ (τ₁+τ₂)/(τ₁τ₂)）
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:3dce9bc01b0e55.description: The stability condition for the system with L(s)=K/(s(τ₁s+1)(τ₂s+1)) is K ≤ (τ₁+τ₂)/(τ₁τ₂).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:401f3abae3185b.label: L(s)=K₁/(s(s-1))系统不稳定
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:401f3abae3185b.description: For the open-loop transfer function L(s)=K₁/(s(s-1)), the system is unstable irrespective of the value of the gain K₁.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:449eee60f76695.label: 虚轴根条件
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:449eee60f76695.description: The system has roots on the jω-axis when u=-1 or K=(τ_1+τ_2)/(τ_1 τ_2).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:5b690dfd39e26d.label: 回路传递函数 L2(jω) 定义
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:5b690dfd39e26d.description: Equation (9.51) defines the loop transfer function L2(jω)=G_c(jω)G(jω)=1/(jω(jω+1)^2).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:5bfcfe597cce1b.label: 双实极点回路传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:5bfcfe597cce1b.description: The loop transfer function for a unity feedback system with two real poles.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:5d50094c95bc8e.label: ω=√5时 L(jω) = K/2
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:5d50094c95bc8e.description: When ω = √5, the value of L(jω) is K/2.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:5e37c7227fe713.label: 实轴交点幅值 u 表达式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:5e37c7227fe713.description: The magnitude of the real part of L(jω) at the real-axis intersection frequency is u = -Kτ₁τ₂/(τ₁+τ₂).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:61d743807e7273.label: 增益裕度公式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:61d743807e7273.description: Equation (9.46) gives the gain margin as the reciprocal of |L(jω)| when the phase shift is -180°, equal to [K2 τ1 τ2/(τ1+τ2)]^{-1} = 1/d.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:66b3d7b842dd7c.label: 开环传递函数奈奎斯特图
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:66b3d7b842dd7c.description: Nyquist contour plot in the L(s)-plane for the open-loop transfer function L(s)=K/(s²(τs+1)), showing a contour Γ_L that encircles the -1 point twice, indicating instability.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:67be5892597d8c.label: 稳定性条件不等式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:67be5892597d8c.description: The stability condition for the system with L(s)=K/(s(τ₁s+1)(τ₂s+1)) is -Kτ₁τ₂/(τ₁+τ₂) ≥ -1.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:69ea4fea57a4c2.label: N = Z - P = -1 示例计算
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:69ea4fea57a4c2.description: Example calculation of N for a contour enclosing one pole and no zeros, resulting in one counterclockwise encirclement.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:6b7d5773c96940.label: 二阶系统回路传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:6b7d5773c96940.description: Equation (9.52) defines the loop transfer function L(s)=G_c(s)G(s)=ω_n^2/(s(s+2ζω_n)) for a second-order system.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:6cb809f83b30cd.label: L(jω)在ω→+∞时的渐近行为
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:6cb809f83b30cd.description: The limit of L(jω) as ω approaches +∞ for the system with a pole at the origin.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:6e4dcfb9372d35.label: L(s)=K₁(1+K₂s)/(s(s-1))的奈奎斯特图
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:6e4dcfb9372d35.description: Nyquist plot in the L(s)-plane for the open-loop transfer function L(s) = K1(1 + K2 s) / (s(s - 1)), showing the locus as frequency ω varies, with a shaded region representing the mapping of the Nyquist contour.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:7953fc7f913054.label: 映射F(s)=2s+1的虚部
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:7953fc7f913054.description: The imaginary part of the mapping F(s)=2s+1, derived from the function.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:7adeb0e03dec40.label: 奈奎斯特图
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:7adeb0e03dec40.description: Nyquist plot in the L(s)-plane for the open-loop transfer function L(s)=K₁/(s(s-1)), showing a contour Γ_L that encircles the -1 point once clockwise.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:7de00c56a50358.label: 大圆弧上L(s)的极限（s=re^(jφ), r→∞）
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:7de00c56a50358.description: On the large semicircle where s=re^(jφ) as r→∞, L(s) for L(s)=K₁/(s(s-1)) approaches |K₁/r²| e^(-2jφ).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:8172e10eb994a2.label: 奈奎斯特图（L(s)平面）
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:8172e10eb994a2.description: Nyquist plot in the L(s)-plane for the open-loop transfer function L(s)=K₁(1+K₂s)/(s(s-1)) with derivative feedback (K₂>0).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:82c2beb1de236d.label: 小半圆上L(s)的极限
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:82c2beb1de236d.description: On the small semicircular detour at the origin where s=εe^(jφ), L(s) for L(s)=K/(s²(τs+1)) approaches K/ε² e^(-2jφ) as ε→0.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:84d95023c56a1e.label: 例9.6的L(jω)/K奈奎斯特图
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:84d95023c56a1e.description: Nyquist plot in the L(s)-plane for L(jω)/K of Example 9.6, showing the frequency response for stability analysis, with solid line for positive frequencies and dashed line for negative frequencies.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:89688a9c00f610.label: L(jω)与-1+j0交点条件K=1/2
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:89688a9c00f610.description: The Nyquist plot of L(jω) intersects the -1+j0 point when K = 1/2.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:8ea0d3b4b968dd.label: ω=0+时 L(jω) = -2K
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:8ea0d3b4b968dd.description: At ω = 0+, the value of L(jω) is -2K.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:8eb4372b6fa056.label: 增益裕量 15 dB
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:8eb4372b6fa056.description: The logarithmic magnitude when the phase angle is -180° is -15 dB, and therefore the gain margin is G.M. = 15 dB.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:8f08303de6bb5a.label: 右半平面零点数Z=1
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:8f08303de6bb5a.description: Number of zeros of the system in the right-hand plane when K > 1/2, computed from the Nyquist criterion.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:95bd69935ed07d.label: 三极点系统L(jω)表达式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:95bd69935ed07d.description: The expression for L(jω) for the system with three poles, used to investigate stability.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:9ce96d854d6338.label: 环路传递函数L(jω)
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:9ce96d854d6338.description: Equation (9.44) defines the loop transfer function L(jω)=G_c(jω)G(jω)=K/(jω(jωτ_1+1)(jωτ_2+1)).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:9d366bfc502167.label: 系统不稳定结论
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:9d366bfc502167.description: For the open-loop transfer function L(s)=K/(s²(τs+1)), the system is unstable irrespective of the gain K.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:9dbbf3fc61a6fb.label: 频率响应表达式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:9dbbf3fc61a6fb.description: The frequency response of L(s)=K/(s²(τs+1)) is L(jω)=K/(-ω²(jωτ+1)) with magnitude K/[ω⁴+τ²ω⁶]^(1/2) and angle -π - tan⁻¹(ωτ).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:a3f9fe3dfd2bf3.label: L(s)=K₁/(s(s-1))的频率响应
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:a3f9fe3dfd2bf3.description: The frequency response of L(s)=K₁/(s(s-1)) is L(jω)=K₁/(jω(jω-1)) = K₁/(ω²+ω⁴)^(1/2) ∠ (-π/2 - tan⁻¹(-ω)) = K₁/(ω²+ω⁴)^(1/2) ∠ (π/2 + tan⁻¹ω).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:a4866c62b05430.label: 对数增益裕度计算示例
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:a4866c62b05430.description: Equation (9.49) gives the logarithmic measure of the gain margin for the example: 20 log 4 = 12 dB.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:a8e419b757220f.label: 奈奎斯特图（L(s)平面，K=1,2,3）
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:a8e419b757220f.description: Nyquist plot in the L(s)-plane for the open-loop transfer function L(s)=K/(s(s+1)²), showing three cases: K=1 (stable), K=2 (marginally stable), and K=3 (unstable).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:a9d1be363c48de.label: 虚部为零条件
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:a9d1be363c48de.description: Condition for the L(jω)-locus to intersect the u-axis, where the imaginary part of L(jω) is zero.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:b013c83bde6c62.label: L(s)平面奈奎斯特图
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:b013c83bde6c62.description: Nyquist plot in the L(s)-plane for the open-loop transfer function L(s)=K/(s(τ₁s+1)(τ₂s+1)), showing a closed contour Γ_L that crosses the negative real axis at -Kτ₁τ₂/(τ₁+τ₂) and encircles the -1 point twice.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:b3a9edb196be9b.label: 负虚轴映射
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:b3a9edb196be9b.description: The mapping of the portion of the Nyquist contour from ω=-∞ to ω=0- through the function L(-jω).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:b7303df7e0f226.label: F'(s) 等于回路传递函数 L(s)
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:b7303df7e0f226.description: The function F'(s) defined as F(s)-1, which equals the loop transfer function L(s).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:b967aaead49557.label: 相位裕度随增益K变化曲线
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:b967aaead49557.description: A plot of phase margin in degrees versus gain K on a logarithmic scale, showing a decreasing curve that crosses zero at K*=128.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:be489b7c51fa8f.label: 大半圆上L(s)的极限
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:be489b7c51fa8f.description: On the large semicircle where s=re^(jφ) as r→∞, L(s) for L(s)=K₁(1+K₂s)/(s(s-1)) approaches |K₁K₂/r| e^(-jφ).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:c028a7dc9f1173.label: L(jω)虚部v表达式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:c028a7dc9f1173.description: The imaginary part v of L(jω) for L(s)=K/(s(τ₁s+1)(τ₂s+1)) is given by v = -K(1/ω)(1-ω²τ₁τ₂) / (1+ω²(τ₁²+τ₂²)+ω⁴τ₁²τ₂²).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:ce30738a98922e.label: 小半圆绕行时 L(s) 的极限
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:ce30738a98922e.description: On the small semicircular detour at the origin where s=εe^(jφ), L(s) for L(s)=K₁/(s(s-1)) approaches |K₁/ε| ∠ -180°-φ as ε→0.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:ce7f975cced13a.label: 增益裕度指示的增益增加倍数
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:ce7f975cced13a.description: The gain margin indicates that the system gain can be increased by a factor of four (12 dB) before the stability boundary is reached.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:d10927b1a90bf3.label: 映射实部公式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:d10927b1a90bf3.description: The real part of the mapping F(s)=2s+1, derived from the function.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:d28f717bdebf4e.label: L(jω)表达式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:d28f717bdebf4e.description: Expression for L(jω) derived from the open-loop transfer function L(s) = K1(1 + K2 s) / (s(s - 1)).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:d5db2a1a3e1eaa.label: 阻尼比近似公式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:d5db2a1a3e1eaa.description: An approximate formula for damping ratio derived from phase margin for a specific system.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:d70628246d3707.label: 二阶反馈控制系统
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:d70628246d3707.description: A second-order feedback control system with forward path gains K₁, 1/(s-1), and 1/s, and feedback gains -K₂ and -1.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:dd6f31c4d84b1c.label: 稳定增益范围0<K≤1/2
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:dd6f31c4d84b1c.description: The system is stable for the limited range of gain 0 < K ≤ 1/2.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:e3d5f7350151aa.label: L(jω)在ω→0+时的极限
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:e3d5f7350151aa.description: As ω approaches 0+, L(jω) for L(s)=K/(s²(τs+1)) approaches |K/ω²| ∠ -π.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:e5544823faf85e.label: 回路传递函数L(s)
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:e5544823faf85e.description: The loop transfer function for the system considered in the example.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:e824c0f459b538.label: 实轴交点处L(jω)实部u
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:e824c0f459b538.description: The real part u of L(jω) at the real-axis intersection frequency ω=1/√(τ₁τ₂) is u = -Kτ₁τ₂/(τ₁+τ₂).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:e8bc5c9437bf01.label: 原点小半圆绕行的映射极限
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:e8bc5c9437bf01.description: The limit expression for the mapping of the small semicircular detour around the pole at the origin in the s-plane.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:eef69105fee1ce.label: L(jω)高频渐近行为（ω→∞）
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:eef69105fee1ce.description: The limit of L(jω) as ω approaches +∞ for the system with three poles.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:efec35dbd39488.label: 线性映射函数F(s)=2s+1
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:efec35dbd39488.description: A linear function used to map a square contour from the s-plane to the F(s)-plane, illustrating conformal mapping.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:eff15675b2e39a.label: L(jω) 当 ω→+∞ 的极限
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:eff15675b2e39a.description: As ω approaches +∞, L(jω) for L(s)=K/(s²(τs+1)) approaches K/ω³ ∠ -3π/2.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:f2d0315c61cc44.label: F(s)=s/(s+1/2)映射示例
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:f2d0315c61cc44.description: A rational function used to map a unit square contour from the s-plane to the F(s)-plane, resulting in no encirclement of the origin.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:f321766da07343.label: Z=N+P关系式
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:f321766da07343.description: The number of closed-loop right-half-plane roots Z is given by Z=N+P=2 for the system with L(s)=K₁/(s(s-1)).

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:f5fedc78d1ffab.label: 重排后的穿越频率方程
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:f5fedc78d1ffab.description: Equation (9.56) is the rearranged form of Equation (9.55) as (ω_c^2)^2 + 4ζ^2 ω_n^2 (ω_c^2) - ω_n^4 = 0.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:f9e61aedd0ea44.label: 百分比超调量
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:f9e61aedd0ea44.description: The approximate percent overshoot to a step input for the system with damping ratio 0.43.

ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:fcf91d76c2c634.label: 开环传递函数（右半平面零点）
ctkg:m3-v1i:source-object:fcf91d76c2c634.description: Open-loop transfer function for Example 9.6, a system with a zero in the right-hand s-plane.

ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:03e84e6868b.label: 开环系统单位阶跃稳态误差
ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:03e84e6868b.description: The steady-state error of the open-loop control system for a unit step input, given by the limit of s times the error expression.

ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:2797d3aa913.label: 开环系统拉普拉斯域误差
ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:2797d3aa913.description: The error of the open-loop control system in the Laplace domain, given by E_0(s) = (1 - G_c(s)G(s))R(s) when T_d(s)=0.

ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:451d032cc72.label: 闭环跟踪误差
ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:451d032cc72.description: The tracking error of the closed-loop system in the Laplace domain when T_d(s)=0, N(s)=0, and H(s)=1, given by E_c(s) = 1/(1+G_c(s)G(s)) R(s).

ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:48edbd2340e.label: 终值定理
ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:48edbd2340e.description: The theorem that the steady-state value of a time-domain signal can be found from the limit of s times its Laplace transform as s approaches zero.

ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:4f003638ec5.label: 直流增益
ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:4f003638ec5.description: The value of the product G_c(s)G(s) when s=0, normally greater than one.

ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:78740004842.label: 闭环系统单位阶跃稳态误差
ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:78740004842.description: The steady-state error of the closed-loop system for a unit step input, given by the limit of s times the error expression.

ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:a917ed3f939.label: 瞬态响应
ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:a917ed3f939.description: The response of a system as a function of time before steady-state.

ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:c08c249b4c0.label: 稳态误差
ctkg:m3-v1j:canonical-object:c08c249b4c0.description: The error after the transient response has decayed, leaving only the continuous response.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:1a28a32a16e8a0.label: 示例系统开环稳态误差
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:1a28a32a16e8a0.description: The steady-state error of the open-loop system for the example with G(s)=K/(τs+1) and G_c(s)=K_a/(τ_1 s+1) under a unit step input.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:1cecfaf08f3ef5.label: 速度控制系统阶跃指令输入
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:1cecfaf08f3ef5.description: Step command input signal for the speed control system.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:1e7d2b06f6153e.label: 闭环速度控制系统传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:1e7d2b06f6153e.description: Closed-loop transfer function of the speed control system with tachometer feedback.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:25a456a39a2bb9.label: 对Km变化的闭环灵敏度
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:25a456a39a2bb9.description: Sensitivity of the closed-loop system to a variation in the motor constant K_m.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:26e83a5c4ae03b.label: 闭环误差拉普拉斯表达式
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:26e83a5c4ae03b.description: The closed-loop error in the Laplace domain expressed as the difference between the reference input and the product of the closed-loop transfer function and the reference input.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:28436b046e0bc5.label: 开环速度控制系统输出响应
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:28436b046e0bc5.description: Output response of the open-loop speed control system in the s-domain.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:3ad016a91b6761.label: 闭环瞬态响应指数参数p
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:3ad016a91b6761.description: Exponent parameter in the closed-loop transient response, defined as p = (1 + Ka Kt K1) / τ1.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:4125eed360fcfd.label: 开环速度控制系统传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:4125eed360fcfd.description: Transfer function of the open-loop speed control system relating output speed to armature voltage.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:42f996628bd68e.label: 示例系统控制器传递函数G_c(s)
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:42f996628bd68e.description: The controller transfer function for the example system, given by G_c(s) = K_a / (τ_1 s + 1).

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:4427c86a085c4a.label: 典型参数下闭环灵敏度
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:4427c86a085c4a.description: Closed-loop sensitivity evaluated with typical parameter values.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:47ac892a07418c.label: 开环速度控制系统
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:47ac892a07418c.description: A speed control system operated without feedback, consisting of an amplifier and motor.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:4af72019ad7219.label: 增益漂移引起的开环稳态误差变化
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:4af72019ad7219.description: The magnitude of the open-loop steady-state error change when the process gain drifts by ΔK/K=0.1, relative to the reference input magnitude.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:4b8e529f84c91f.label: 示例过程传递函数G(s)
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:4b8e529f84c91f.description: The process transfer function for the example system, given by G(s) = K / (τ s + 1).

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:4f54746df3b885.label: 闭环稳态误差相对变化
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:4f54746df3b885.description: The relative change in closed-loop steady-state error due to a 10% gain decrease, relative to the reference input magnitude.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:556e8772a71e6a.label: 增益常数K1
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:556e8772a71e6a.description: Gain constant defined as K1 = Km / (Ra b + Kb Km).

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:621d9a4c34dc0f.label: 示例系统闭环稳态误差
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:621d9a4c34dc0f.description: The steady-state error of the closed-loop system for the example with G(s)=K/(τs+1) and G_c(s)=K_a/(τ_1 s+1) under a unit step input.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:94b07b3db33bf9.label: 增益漂移引起的闭环稳态误差变化
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:94b07b3db33bf9.description: The change in closed-loop steady-state error when the process gain decreases by ΔK/K=0.1, from the original value.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:9a164e86e976ea.label: 闭环传递函数T(s)
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:9a164e86e976ea.description: The closed-loop transfer function for the example system, given by T(s) = G_c(s)G(s) / (1 + G_c(s)G(s)).

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:9bec5302a6422b.label: 开环瞬态转速变化
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:9bec5302a6422b.description: Transient speed change of the open-loop system in the time domain.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:c2204edf7f0e2b.label: 由闭环传递函数表示的稳态误差
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:c2204edf7f0e2b.description: The steady-state error of the closed-loop system expressed using the closed-loop transfer function T(s), given by e_c(∞) = 1 - T(0).

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:d01bb654895db7.label: 测速发电机反馈闭环速度控制系统
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:d01bb654895db7.description: A speed control system with tachometer feedback, allowing adjustment of amplifier gain to meet transient response specifications.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:d32e165eaa3e5a.label: 时间常数τ1
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:d32e165eaa3e5a.description: Time constant defined as τ1 = Ra J / (Ra b + Kb Km).

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:ddd90ea6887225.label: 阶跃输入下闭环瞬态响应
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:ddd90ea6887225.description: Transient response of the closed-loop system to a step change in input command.

ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:e5be7aab159535.label: 大负载惯性下近似闭环瞬态响应
ctkg:m3-v1j:source-object:e5be7aab159535.description: Approximate transient response of the closed-loop system for large load inertia.

ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:0afb07f025b.label: 纯时延传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:0afb07f025b.description: The Laplace transform of a pure time delay is G_D(s) = e^{-s T_d}.

ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:13a498eacc1.label: 纯时延相位滞后随频率增长
ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:13a498eacc1.description: The phase lag of a pure time delay grows increasingly negative in proportion to frequency, and is greater than 270° for ω T_d greater than about 5 rad.

ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:31f8a3f2fee.label: 纯时延系统的奈奎斯特判据
ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:31f8a3f2fee.description: Frequency domain concepts such as the Nyquist criterion apply directly to systems with pure time delay, requiring no approximations.

ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:39ac7c77fc6.label: 帕德近似
ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:39ac7c77fc6.description: A rational function approximation of a pure time delay transfer function e^{-s T_d}.

ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:65b1a16a657.label: 纯时延频率响应的幅值
ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:65b1a16a657.description: The magnitude of the frequency response of a pure time delay is 1 for all frequencies.

ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:b36a0cecee2.label: 纯时延频率响应的相位
ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:b36a0cecee2.description: The phase of the frequency response of a pure time delay is -ω T_d radians.

ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:b810a9c95ee.label: 时延对系统带宽的约束
ctkg:m3-v1k:canonical-object:b810a9c95ee.description: A time delay places a constraint on the achievable bandwidth of any system; it is virtually impossible to stabilize a system with a crossover frequency greater than ω = 5 / T_d, and difficult for frequencies greater than ω ≈ 3 / T_d.

ctkg:m3-v1k:source-object:399d60c19f3d57.label: 奈奎斯特图评估时延效应
ctkg:m3-v1k:source-object:399d60c19f3d57.description: A method to evaluate the effect of a time delay using a Nyquist diagram.

ctkg:m3-v1k:source-object:4481d71192824e.label: 相位滞后限制下的最大可容忍时延
ctkg:m3-v1k:source-object:4481d71192824e.description: To limit the phase lag to 20° at ω = 5 rad/sec, the maximum tolerable T_d is 0.07 sec, so the slowest sampling acceptable is T_s = 0.14 sec.

ctkg:m3-v1k:source-object:45f43c3a81a468.label: 采样引起的相位滞后
ctkg:m3-v1k:source-object:45f43c3a81a468.description: The phase lag due to sampling at a crossover frequency of 5 rad/sec with a sample period of 0.05 sec is -7°.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:0288016a761.label: 闭环带宽
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:0288016a761.description: The frequency at which the closed-loop magnitude is -3 dB, denoted ω_B.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:035444f94f4.label: 时延因子仅引入相移
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:035444f94f4.description: The factor e^{-sT} adds a phase shift to the frequency response without altering the magnitude curve.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:091491fcc4f.label: 闭环传递函数相角关系式
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:091491fcc4f.description: The phase angle φ of the closed-loop transfer function T(jω) expressed in terms of the real and imaginary parts u and v of the loop transfer function L(jω).

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:0cfddb7e1b4.label: M_{pω}指标
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:0cfddb7e1b4.description: An index used in frequency-domain-to-time-domain correlations to estimate damping ratio.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:0fe6155260a.label: 时延引起的相位偏移
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:0fe6155260a.description: Phase shift resulting from the time delay factor e^{-jωT}.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:13d83bbb2d7.label: 一阶帕德近似的级数展开
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:13d83bbb2d7.description: Series expansion of the first-order Padé approximation of e^{-sT}.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:304f9ab2e35.label: 时延引入附加相位滞后并降低系统稳定性
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:304f9ab2e35.description: A time delay e^{-sT} in a feedback system introduces an additional phase lag and results in a less stable system.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:31682a8d4ad.label: 一阶帕德近似系数匹配方程
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:31682a8d4ad.description: Equations obtained by equating the corresponding coefficients of the terms in s for the first-order Padé approximation of e^{-sT}.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:39aeb494577.label: 低频幅值为0 dB时带宽在-3 dB频率处测量
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:39aeb494577.description: In systems where the low-frequency magnitude is 0 dB on the Bode plot, the bandwidth is measured at the -3 dB frequency.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:40708b499a9.label: 谐振频率ωr
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:40708b499a9.description: The frequency at which the maximum magnitude of the closed-loop frequency response occurs, denoted ω_r.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:517b7f4cf4b.label: 一阶帕德近似系数解
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:517b7f4cf4b.description: Solution for n0, d0, n1, and d1 in the first-order Padé approximation of e^{-sT}.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:53d87e756f3.label: 时滞的有理函数近似
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:53d87e756f3.description: It would be helpful if we could obtain a rational function approximation of the time-delay, making it more convenient to incorporate the delay into the block diagram for analysis and design purposes.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:563362810a1.label: 闭环控制系统带宽
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:563362810a1.description: The bandwidth of a closed-loop control system is a measure of the system's response, measured at the -3 dB frequency on the Bode plot when the low-frequency magnitude is 0 dB.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:61290f3ec77.label: 帕德近似
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:61290f3ec77.description: A method that uses a series expansion of the transcendental function e^{-sT} and matches as many coefficients as possible with a series expansion of a rational function of specified order to obtain a rational function approximation of the time-delay.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:66b3015c18e.label: M_{pω}与二阶系统阻尼比ζ的关系
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:66b3015c18e.description: The maximum magnitude of the closed-loop frequency response M_{pω} is related to the damping ratio ζ of a second-order system by the formula M_{pω} = (2 ζ sqrt(1-ζ^2))^{-1}, valid for ζ < 0.707.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:7471fc3264c.label: 降低回路增益换取稳定性导致稳态误差增大
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:7471fc3264c.description: Reducing loop gain to obtain stability increases the steady-state error of the system.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:9536bb480a0.label: 时延
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:9536bb480a0.description: The time interval between the start of an event at one point in a system and its resulting action at another point in the system.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:a206ab29983.label: 一阶有理函数级数展开
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:a206ab29983.description: Series expansion of a first-order rational function (n1 s + n0) / (d1 s + d0).

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:ab595ab23ab.label: 闭环传递函数幅值M(ω)表达式
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:ab595ab23ab.description: The magnitude of the closed-loop transfer function M(ω) expressed in terms of the real and imaginary parts u and v of the loop transfer function L(jω) = u + jv.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:ae84642eb07.label: 含时延的回路传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:ae84642eb07.description: Loop transfer function including a time delay factor e^{-sT}.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:c5f7d0ab3bb.label: 开环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:c5f7d0ab3bb.description: The loop transfer function L(jω) = G_c(jω)G(jω), used in the Nyquist criterion and phase margin index.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:cbba3535f12.label: e^{-sT}的麦克劳林级数展开
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:cbba3535f12.description: Maclaurin series expansion of the transcendental function e^{-sT}.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:ccb5acec315.label: 时延系统奈奎斯特判据有效性
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:ccb5acec315.description: The Nyquist criterion remains valid for a system with a time delay because the factor e^{-sT} does not introduce any additional poles or zeros within the contour.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:d266cb011d4.label: 穿越频率与闭环带宽的近似关系ω_B=1.6ω_c
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:d266cb011d4.description: An empirical approximation relating the crossover frequency ω_c on the open-loop Bode plot to the closed-loop system bandwidth ω_B, given by ω_B = 1.6 ω_c, valid for damping ratio ζ in the range 0.2 to 0.8.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:dd2d1568c7e.label: 带宽与响应速度关系
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:dd2d1568c7e.description: The speed of response to a step input is roughly proportional to the bandwidth ω_B, and the settling time is inversely proportional to ω_B.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:e265cacbe18.label: 时延参数T
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:e265cacbe18.description: The parameter T representing the delay time in a time delay transfer function.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:e4aa1efbfab.label: 尼科尔斯图
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:e4aa1efbfab.description: A chart depicting the frequency response of a loop transfer function G_c(jω)G(jω) with loop gain in dB on the vertical axis and loop phase in degrees on the horizontal axis, used to analyze stability margins and closed-loop frequency response.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:ef0b8445426.label: 闭环频率响应的最大幅值Mpω
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:ef0b8445426.description: The maximum magnitude of the closed-loop frequency response, denoted M_{pω}, which can be related to the damping ratio of a second-order system.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:f44768e1f84.label: 一阶Padé近似e^{-sT}
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:f44768e1f84.description: First-order rational function approximation of e^{-sT} using the Padé approximation method.

ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:f838b609986.label: 含时延的回路传递函数频率响应
ctkg:m3-v1l:canonical-object:f838b609986.description: Frequency response of the loop transfer function including a time delay factor.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:0c463d88cdb902.label: 阻尼比大于0.30时Mpω需小于1.75(4.9 dB)
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:0c463d88cdb902.description: From Equation (9.63), a damping ratio greater than 0.30 requires M_{pω} to be less than 1.75 (4.9 dB).

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:1239189c82658b.label: 阻尼比大于0.30所需增益K<0.50
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:1239189c82658b.description: To achieve a damping ratio greater than 0.30, the gain K must be less than 0.50, obtained by reducing K=0.64 by a factor of 1.28.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:3722770d109278.label: 利用Nichols图调整增益K以提供合适相位裕度和Mpω的方法
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:3722770d109278.description: A method to adjust the system gain K by inspecting the Nichols chart to provide a suitable phase margin and M_{pω}, as demonstrated in Example 9.8.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:3afdffa9e0c2f1.label: 利用Nichols图确定闭环频率响应
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:3afdffa9e0c2f1.description: A method to determine the closed-loop frequency response by plotting the open-loop frequency response on the Nichols chart and reading the constant M and N contours to obtain closed-loop magnitude and phase.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:46dfb106a86296.label: 共轭复根阻尼比ζ=0.124
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:46dfb106a86296.description: The damping ratio of the complex conjugate roots is equal to 0.124.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:4fea79cbd403e9.label: 由相位裕度估计阻尼比
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:4fea79cbd403e9.description: For the system in Example 9.8, using Equation (9.58) with a phase margin of 30°, the estimated damping ratio is ζ = 0.30.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:543ae942810b48.label: 液位控制系统含时延回路传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:543ae942810b48.description: Loop transfer function for the liquid level control system example with time delay.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:595f8f60c39485.label: 频域-时域关联不确定时采用阻尼比下限值
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:595f8f60c39485.description: When frequency-domain-to-time-domain correlations are uncertain, the lower value of the damping ratio resulting from the phase margin and the M_{pω} relation is safe for analysis and design purposes.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:595fda73e4dbf1.label: 等M圆
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:595fda73e4dbf1.description: Circles of constant magnitude of the closed-loop transfer function plotted on the magnitude-phase plot, used to determine key performance indicators such as M_{pω} and ω_r for unity feedback systems.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:5f27bfd07e86bf.label: M=1时的等M圆
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:5f27bfd07e86bf.description: When M=1, the constant M-circle becomes the straight line u = -1/2.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:68beae0504f5a2.label: 1+L(s)的特征方程因式分解形式
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:68beae0504f5a2.description: The factored characteristic equation for 1+L(s) obtained from the roots of the characteristic equation.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:6f2f2190ad47ea.label: 系统T1(s)的调节时间T_s=0.8 s
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:6f2f2190ad47ea.description: The settling time of system T1(s) is T_s = 0.8 s.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:72adfce8056200.label: 系统T1(s)的自然频率为ω_n1=10 rad/s
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:72adfce8056200.description: The natural frequency of system T1(s) is ω_n1 = 10 rad/s.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:8371ec05a8583b.label: 轧钢机控制系统中的时延T=d/v
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:8371ec05a8583b.description: The time delay between the roll adjustment and the thickness measurement in a steel rolling mill control system, given by T = d/v.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:858936316bcdf9.label: 例9.8的回路传递函数L(s)
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:858936316bcdf9.description: The loop transfer function L(s) = G_c(s)G(s) used in Example 9.8.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:87cc9c0cb52ffe.label: T1(s)闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:87cc9c0cb52ffe.description: Closed-loop transfer function of a second-order system with natural frequency 10 rad/s and damping ratio 0.5.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:928b080fe2c1be.label: 系统T1(s)的峰值时间T_p=0.12s
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:928b080fe2c1be.description: The peak time of system T1(s) is T_p = 0.12 s.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:97f31996988321.label: 等M圆方程
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:97f31996988321.description: The equation of a circle on the (u, v)-plane representing constant magnitude M of the closed-loop transfer function, with center at (M^2/(1-M^2), 0) and radius |M/(1-M^2)|.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:9d4f0dffab682b.label: 无时延相位裕度40°
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:9d4f0dffab682b.description: The phase margin of the liquid level control system without the pure time delay is 40 degrees.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:a2696a43bfd126.label: 由方程(9.63)解得阻尼比ζ=0.18
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:a2696a43bfd126.description: Solving Equation (9.63) yields a damping ratio ζ=0.18.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:a36585a9c3969f.label: 增益降低5dB以获得30度相位裕度
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:a36585a9c3969f.description: To provide a phase margin of 30 degrees, the gain of the liquid level control system must be decreased by a factor of 5 dB, to K = 31.5 / 1.78 = 17.7.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:a96b46a9c7ca7f.label: 例9.8的Mpω线性值
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:a96b46a9c7ca7f.description: For the system in Example 9.8, 20 log M_{pω} = 9 dB, or M_{pω} = 2.8.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:b91aaea2085e02.label: 例9.7中系统在ω_r=0.8处的闭环相角为-72°
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:b91aaea2085e02.description: For the system in Example 9.7, the closed-loop phase angle at ω_r = 0.8 is equal to -72°.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:bc254b2e725926.label: 大带宽提供更快响应
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:bc254b2e725926.description: The system with a larger bandwidth provides a faster response.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:bc4992f4cba113.label: 系统T1(s)和T2(s)的阻尼比均为0.5
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:bc4992f4cba113.description: Both systems T1(s) and T2(s) have a damping ratio ζ = 0.5.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:be86764c8f94ed.label: 系统T1(s)和T2(s)的百分比超调量均为16%
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:be86764c8f94ed.description: Both systems T1(s) and T2(s) have a percent overshoot of 16%.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:cc2ba171fbeadb.label: 等N圆方程
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:cc2ba171fbeadb.description: The equation of a circle on the (u, v)-plane representing constant closed-loop phase angle φ, where N = tan φ, with center at (-1/2, 1/(2N)) and radius (1/2) sqrt(1 + 1/N^2).

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:ce484458638cd1.label: 等N圆（恒定闭环相角圆）
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:ce484458638cd1.description: Circles of constant closed-loop phase angle plotted on the magnitude-phase diagram, derived from the angle relation of the closed-loop transfer function.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:d3f1ac1eff57ff.label: 利用等M圆从开环频率响应求闭环频率响应
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:d3f1ac1eff57ff.description: A method to obtain the closed-loop frequency response from the open-loop frequency response by plotting the L(jω) locus on the magnitude-phase plot and reading the magnitude M of the constant M-circles that the locus intersects at various frequencies.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:d869815552dccc.label: 尼科尔斯图
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:d869815552dccc.description: A log-magnitude-phase diagram where constant M and N circles are transformed into contours, used for analysis and design of control systems.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:e2fc5f8d6dcf3e.label: 开环传递函数G_C(jω)G(jω)的尼科尔斯图
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:e2fc5f8d6dcf3e.description: Nichols chart for the loop transfer function G_C(jω)G(jω)=0.64/(jω[(jω)^2+jω+1]) with frequency points labeled 1.2, 1.0, 0.9, 0.72, and 0.45.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:e3cc65aeabd783.label: 例9.8的最大幅值Mpω
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:e3cc65aeabd783.description: For the system in Example 9.8, the maximum magnitude M_{pω} is equal to +9 dB, occurring at a frequency ω_r = 0.88.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:e833d3bc621750.label: 系统T1(s)的带宽
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:e833d3bc621750.description: The bandwidth of system T1(s) is 12.7 rad/s.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:e846be1d3291b9.label: 液位控制系统时延
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:e846be1d3291b9.description: The time delay between the valve adjustment and the fluid output in a liquid level control system, given by T = d/v.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:f038c072583a2f.label: 从M圆估计闭环频率响应幅值
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:f038c072583a2f.description: The closed-loop frequency response magnitude curves can be estimated by reading the magnitude M of the circles that the L(jω)-locus intersects at several frequencies.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:f73a04099fadcc.label: 轧钢机控制系统时延公式T=d/v
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:f73a04099fadcc.description: Formula for the time delay between roll adjustment and thickness measurement in a steel rolling mill control system.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:f90d72b10eb672.label: 例9.8系统的相位裕度
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:f90d72b10eb672.description: For the system in Example 9.8, the phase margin determined from the Nichols chart is 30°.

ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:fe09049556fc08.label: 例9.8三阶系统回路传递函数
ctkg:m3-v1l:source-object:fe09049556fc08.description: A unity feedback system with loop transfer function L(s) = 0.64 / (s(s^2 + s + 1)), where ζ = 0.5 for the complex poles.

ctkg:modelrepresentation:15eb09f5651e8de.label: Feedforward Control Structure for Disturbance Rejection
ctkg:modelrepresentation:15eb09f5651e8de.description: Block diagram where the disturbance W passes through the plant inverse DC gain G^{-1}(0) before entering the plant G(s), while the feedback loop handles the reference tracking.

ctkg:modelrepresentation:42faa6d08b26b66.label: 二次型李雅普诺夫函数候选

ctkg:modelrepresentation:56f1adca244fd06.label: 磁盘驱动采样读取系统结构图

ctkg:modelrepresentation:5e76afd7ab1f94c.label: 按扰动补偿的复合控制系统结构图
ctkg:modelrepresentation:5e76afd7ab1f94c.description: 图6-33所示系统结构，包含前馈补偿装置Gn(s)、反馈部分前向通路传递函数G1(s)和G2(s)，用于补偿可量测扰动N(s)。

ctkg:modelrepresentation:680d23ec58dff79.label: 按输入补偿的复合控制系统结构图
ctkg:modelrepresentation:680d23ec58dff79.description: 图6-35所示系统结构，包含前馈补偿装置Gr(s)和反馈系统开环传递函数G(s)，用于补偿输入信号R(s)。
