ctkg:m3-v2b:canonical-object:12f9f8b6f6f.label: 相对稳定性
ctkg:m3-v2b:canonical-object:12f9f8b6f6f.description: The property of a system measured by the relative real part of each root or pair of roots of the characteristic equation, or by the relative damping coefficients of each complex root pair.

ctkg:m3-v2b:canonical-object:3ed16711b86.label: 轴平移法
ctkg:m3-v2b:canonical-object:3ed16711b86.description: A method to determine the relative stability of a system by shifting the s-plane axis and applying the Routh-Hurwitz criterion to the shifted characteristic equation.

ctkg:m3-v2b:canonical-object:9275aaa5609.label: 相对阻尼系数
ctkg:m3-v2b:canonical-object:9275aaa5609.description: The damping coefficient ζ of each complex root pair, used to define relative stability in terms of speed of response and overshoot.

ctkg:m3-v2b:source-object:3dde22225f47bb.label: 特征方程q(s)
ctkg:m3-v2b:source-object:3dde22225f47bb.description: The third-order characteristic equation used in Example 6.6 to illustrate the axis shift method.

ctkg:m3-v2b:source-object:3f3cf2020b9054.label: 移位特征方程
ctkg:m3-v2b:source-object:3f3cf2020b9054.description: The characteristic equation after substituting s = s_n - 1, yielding s_n^3 + s_n^2 + s_n + 1.

ctkg:m3-v2b:source-object:8bf7fff26521a9.label: 辅助多项式
ctkg:m3-v2b:source-object:8bf7fff26521a9.description: The auxiliary polynomial from the Routh array for the shifted equation, used to find roots on the shifted imaginary axis.

ctkg:m3-v2b:source-object:b25d682cf6846b.label: 移位变量
ctkg:m3-v2b:source-object:b25d682cf6846b.description: The variable obtained by shifting the s-plane axis, defined as s_n = s + 1 in Example 6.6.

ctkg:m3-v2b:source-object:f7a0552cfddba3.label: 移位特征方程的劳斯阵列
ctkg:m3-v2b:source-object:f7a0552cfddba3.description: The Routh array established for the shifted characteristic equation s_n^3 + s_n^2 + s_n + 1, showing a row of zeros at s_n^1.

ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:136c72dc127271.label: 阶跃输入下系统稳定的条件
ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:136c72dc127271.description: For the response to be stable (bounded for a step input), the real part of the poles must be in the left-hand portion of the s-plane.

ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:2728162ee55073.label: 极点决定响应模态，零点决定权重
ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:2728162ee55073.description: The poles of T(s) determine the particular response modes present, and the zeros of T(s) establish the relative weightings of the individual mode functions.

ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:3e88ffe42ed2e0.label: 单位负反馈控制系统的特征方程
ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:3e88ffe42ed2e0.description: For a unity negative feedback control system, the characteristic equation reduces to 1 + G_c(s) G(s) = 0.

ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:592157448b495b.label: 单位阶跃输入下输出Y(s)的部分分式展开
ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:592157448b495b.description: The output Y(s) of a system with DC gain 1, without repeated roots, and a unit step input can be expressed as a partial fraction expansion with a 1/s term, first-order terms, and second-order terms.

ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:ba103fd16ed1a4.label: 瞬态响应y(t)的表达式
ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:ba103fd16ed1a4.description: The inverse transform of the partial fraction expansion results in the transient response y(t) as the sum of a constant 1, exponential terms, and damped sinusoidal terms.

ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:cf9ae12f97ac2e.label: 闭环传递函数T(s)的表达式
ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:cf9ae12f97ac2e.description: The closed-loop transfer function T(s) is the ratio of output Y(s) to input R(s), expressed as the sum of P_i(s) times Delta_i(s) over Delta(s).

ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:d2dc44295608fc.label: 零点靠近极点对系数幅值的影响
ctkg:m3-v2c:source-object:d2dc44295608fc.description: If there is a zero near the pole at s = -sigma_i, then A_i will be much smaller in magnitude.

ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:03050eec261a56.label: 前向矩形积分器传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:03050eec261a56.description: The z-domain transfer function of the forward rectangular integrator, U(z)/X(z) = T z / (z-1).

ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:0d1aa49ded1fe5.label: PID控制器的数字实现
ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:0d1aa49ded1fe5.description: The difference equation (13.58) can be implemented using a digital computer or microprocessor, and a PI or PD controller can be obtained by setting an appropriate gain equal to zero.

ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:2ad95c5cb12db7.label: 后向差分规则
ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:2ad95c5cb12db7.description: Discrete approximation of the time derivative using the backward difference rule at t = kT.

ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:2c433efc6fe64c.label: 前向矩形积分规则
ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:2c433efc6fe64c.description: Discrete approximation of integration using forward rectangular integration at t = kT.

ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:3096b2482f9840.label: 前向矩形积分的z变换
ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:3096b2482f9840.description: The z-transform of the forward rectangular integration rule, giving U(z) = z^{-1} U(z) + T X(z).

ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:59cc5921a01e7d.label: PID控制器z域传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:59cc5921a01e7d.description: The z-domain transfer function of the PID controller, G_c(z) = K_P + (K_I T z)/(z-1) + K_D (z-1)/(T z).

ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:5c2c8d5c96e246.label: 后向差分的z变换
ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:5c2c8d5c96e246.description: The z-transform of the backward difference rule, yielding U(z) = (1 - z^{-1})/T X(z) = (z-1)/(T z) X(z).

ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:762ac4d37f3b07.label: PID控制器s域传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:762ac4d37f3b07.description: The s-domain transfer function of a PID controller, given as G_c(s) = K_P + K_I/s + K_D s.

ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:bc5221e1b6d9b5.label: PID控制器差分方程
ctkg:m3-v2d:source-object:bc5221e1b6d9b5.description: The complete difference equation algorithm for the PID controller, expressed as u(k) = [K_P + K_I T + (K_D/T)] x(k) - K_D T x(k-1) + K_I u(k-1).

ctkg:m3-v2f:canonical-object:d9aed6663ee.label: 内模设计
ctkg:m3-v2f:canonical-object:d9aed6663ee.description: A compensator design method that includes a model of the reference input in the compensator to achieve asymptotic tracking with zero steady-state error.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:1a533376cb56be.label: 斜坡跟踪增广系统
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:1a533376cb56be.description: The augmented system for ramp tracking, given by [e_dot; e_ddot; z_dot] = [[0,1,0],[0,0,C],[0,0,A]] [e; e_dot; z] + [0;0;B] w.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:1ae85e46efb099.label: 内模原理
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:1ae85e46efb099.description: If G(s)G_c(s) contains R(s), then y(t) will track r(t) asymptotically.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:1f99e614ca524a.label: 示例增广系统（阶跃）
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:1f99e614ca524a.description: The augmented system for the example process, given by [e_dot; z_dot] = [[0,1,0],[0,0,1],[0,-2,-2]] [e; z] + [0;0;1] w.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:238cdb0a17d672.label: 阶跃参考输入模型
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:238cdb0a17d672.description: The reference input model for a step input, given by x_r_dot = 0 and r = x_r.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:3bafca95ac7466.label: 跟踪误差
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:3bafca95ac7466.description: The difference between the output and the reference input, defined as e(t) = y(t) - r(t).

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:49641f12e0dfa0.label: 阶跃跟踪反馈律
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:49641f12e0dfa0.description: The feedback law for the augmented system, given by w(t) = -K1 e(t) - K2 z(t).

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:4bf7db79b04868.label: 阶跃跟踪增广系统
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:4bf7db79b04868.description: The augmented system for step tracking, given by [e_dot; z_dot] = [[0, C],[0, A]] [e; z] + [0; B] w.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:94e124d398495c.label: 斜坡参考输入模型
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:94e124d398495c.description: The reference input model for a ramp input, given by x_r_dot = [[0,1],[0,0]] x_r and r = [1,0] x_r.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:a5ca84bc922c69.label: 阶跃跟踪示例过程
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:a5ca84bc922c69.description: A specific process given by x_dot = [[0,1],[-2,-2]] x + [0;1] u, y = [1,0] x.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:ac5860758a3f1d.label: 状态变量模型
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:ac5860758a3f1d.description: A linear time-invariant system described by x_dot = A x + B u, y = C x.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:b7ee75da04ae5e.label: 参考输入模型
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:b7ee75da04ae5e.description: A linear system that generates the reference input, with unknown initial conditions.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:b94fa14089dd39.label: 斜坡跟踪反馈律
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:b94fa14089dd39.description: The feedback law for the ramp tracking augmented system, given by w(t) = -[K1, K2, K3] [e; e_dot; z].

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:caac2bcf8774bb.label: 阶跃跟踪增益示例
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:caac2bcf8774bb.description: The gains K1=20 and K2=[20,10] place the roots of the characteristic equation at s=-1±j and -10.

ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:e43ff2510149d3.label: 阶跃跟踪控制律
ctkg:m3-v2f:source-object:e43ff2510149d3.description: The control input for step tracking, given by u(t) = -K1 * integral of e from 0 to t - K2 * x(t).

ctkg:m3-v2h:canonical-object:0c5c3925013.label: 频率响应匹配法
ctkg:m3-v2h:canonical-object:0c5c3925013.description: A method to obtain a lower-order transfer function by selecting coefficients so that the frequency response of the reduced-order model closely matches that of the original high-order system, ensuring the same steady-state response by keeping the gain constant.

ctkg:m3-v2h:canonical-object:4f950081fe5.label: 劳斯近似法
ctkg:m3-v2h:canonical-object:4f950081fe5.description: A method for reducing the order of a system based on truncating the Routh table used to determine stability, with approximants computed by a finite recursive algorithm.

ctkg:m3-v2h:canonical-object:9428433ffb8.label: 极点删除法
ctkg:m3-v2h:canonical-object:9428433ffb8.description: A method to reduce the order of a transfer function by deleting a pole whose negative real part is much more negative than the other poles, while adjusting the gain to preserve the steady-state response.

ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:1c47e78a9109db.label: 降阶近似传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:1c47e78a9109db.description: A reduced-order transfer function G_L(s) = K (c_p s^p + ... + c_1 s + 1) / (d_g s^g + ... + d_1 s + 1), where p ≤ g < n, and the gain constant K is the same as the original to ensure the same steady-state response.

ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:552dae0908d9e5.label: 高阶传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:552dae0908d9e5.description: A transfer function of a high-order system, expressed as G_H(s) = K (a_m s^m + ... + a_1 s + 1) / (b_n s^n + ... + b_1 s + 1), with poles in the left-hand s-plane and m ≤ n.

ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:575387c0e3d2eb.label: M2q和Δ2q系数
ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:575387c0e3d2eb.description: Coefficients defined as M_{2q} = sum_{k=0}^{2q} [(-1)^{k+q} M^{(k)}(0) M^{(2q-k)}(0)] / [k!(2q-k)!] for q=0,1,2,..., and an analogous equation for Delta_{2q}, used to solve for the coefficients of the reduced-order transfer function.

ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:5d058f6165e112.label: Δ2q的类似方程
ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:5d058f6165e112.description: An analogous equation for Delta_{2q} to that for M_{2q}, used in the frequency response matching method.

ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:c3a63a3f640bdd.label: M2q的定义公式
ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:c3a63a3f640bdd.description: Definition of M_{2q} as a sum involving derivatives of M(s) evaluated at zero, used in the frequency response matching method.

ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:f421e47ca574ee.label: M2q与Δ2q相等
ctkg:m3-v2h:source-object:f421e47ca574ee.description: The solutions for the c and d coefficients are obtained by equating M_{2q} = Delta_{2q} for q=1,2,... up to the number required to solve for the unknown coefficients.

ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:0796a0bb402f02.label: PID控制器传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:0796a0bb402f02.description: The transfer function of a PID controller used in the internal model control system.

ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:49c3ac805ddb91.label: 最坏情况被控对象传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:49c3ac805ddb91.description: The worst-case plant transfer function when the poles of G(s) change by ±50%.

ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:614b964c26980d.label: PI控制1/s被控对象的闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:614b964c26980d.description: The closed-loop transfer function T(s) for the system with PI controller and plant 1/s.

ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:6c7343c9b97d7e.label: PI控制器与1/s被控对象的开环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:6c7343c9b97d7e.description: The product of the PI controller and plant transfer function for a system with G(s)=1/s.

ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:74a2c1f89ffbf3.label: 三阶无超调响应传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:74a2c1f89ffbf3.description: The desired third-order transfer function for a deadbeat response.

ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:90ff774411ebd3.label: ITAE斜坡响应期望闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:90ff774411ebd3.description: The desired closed-loop transfer function for a ramp response using ITAE specifications.

ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:951d517998d79f.label: 内模控制系统的闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2i:source-object:951d517998d79f.description: The closed-loop transfer function of the system in Figure 12.20 with appropriate prefilter.

ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:1595539e1ec89f.label: 伪QFT方法
ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:1595539e1ec89f.description: A simple s-plane, root locus approach to achieving the goals of Quantitative Feedback Theory (QFT) by selecting gain K and compensator G_c(s) through a three-step procedure.

ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:199cf0226e1862.label: 闭环传递函数T(s)
ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:199cf0226e1862.description: The closed-loop transfer function with K=100, showing poles close to zeros and an approximate first-order response.

ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:1dd4d74722ed7a.label: PID控制器
ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:1dd4d74722ed7a.description: The PID controller used in the pseudo-QFT design example to achieve zero steady-state error for a step input.

ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:268ace92387948.label: 补偿器G_c(s)
ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:268ace92387948.description: The specific compensator derived in the example by placing zeros at -0.8 and -1.8.

ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:3c061f88b9a004.label: 被控对象传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:3c061f88b9a004.description: The plant transfer function used in the pseudo-QFT design example, with nominal poles p1=1 and p2=2 and ±50% variation.

ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:4022fed074c5a7.label: 伪QFT极点-零点近似
ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:4022fed074c5a7.description: If the gain K is sufficiently large, then the poles of T(s) are almost equal to the zeros of G_c(s) G(s), leaving one pole of T(s) with a significant partial fraction residue and the system with a phase margin of approximately 90° (actually about 85°).

ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:539b25fac314ab.label: 根轨迹图
ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:539b25fac314ab.description: A root locus plot on the complex plane with σ and jω axes, showing open-loop poles at 0, -1, and -2, open-loop zeros at -0.8 and -1.8, and trajectories of closed-loop poles as gain K varies along the negative real axis.

ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:5b9db9f6bfeb14.label: 定量反馈理论
ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:5b9db9f6bfeb14.description: A design method that uses a controller to achieve robust performance by seeking a wide bandwidth for the closed-loop transfer function with a high loop gain K, typically using graphical and numerical methods in conjunction with the Nichols chart.

ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:98a46e65035604.label: 反馈系统框图
ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:98a46e65035604.description: A block diagram in the s-domain with input R(s), a summing junction, gain K, controller G_c(s), plant G(s), and output Y(s) in a closed-loop configuration.

ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:aded750d4dd3e6.label: 伪QFT鲁棒性能
ctkg:m3-v2j:source-object:aded750d4dd3e6.description: The pseudo-QFT design results in very robust systems; the closed-loop system provides a fast response and possesses a phase margin of 85°, and performance remains essentially unchanged under worst-case conditions.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:09a4d34ede5.label: 加性摄动鲁棒稳定性条件
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:09a4d34ede5.description: Stability is preserved if |A(jω)| < |1+G_c(jω)G(jω)| for all ω.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:128dbaee7c1.label: 灵敏度函数
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:128dbaee7c1.description: The sensitivity function S(s) is defined as 1/(1+G_c(s)G(s)).

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:333b4eccaab.label: 鲁棒控制系统
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:333b4eccaab.description: A control system that maintains acceptable closed-loop performance in the presence of significant model uncertainty, disturbances, and noise.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:346fd894a2c.label: 系统灵敏度与根灵敏度的关系
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:346fd894a2c.description: When the zeros of T(s) are independent of the parameter alpha, the system sensitivity equals the negative sum over the roots of the root sensitivity divided by (s + r_i) for an nth-order system.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:363faba0924.label: 乘性摄动的鲁棒稳定性判据
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:363faba0924.description: Stability is preserved if |M(jω)| < |1+1/(G_c(jω)G(jω))| for all ω.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:36751393b1b.label: 鲁棒性定义
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:36751393b1b.description: Robustness is the low sensitivity to effects not considered in the analysis and design phase, such as disturbances, measurement noise, and unmodeled dynamics.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:4d2e1a99561.label: 灵敏度与补灵敏度函数之和为1
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:4d2e1a99561.description: The sensitivity and complementary sensitivity functions sum to 1.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:5e99209aab3.label: 补灵敏度函数
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:5e99209aab3.description: The complementary sensitivity function C(s) is defined as G_c(s)G(s)/(1+G_c(s)G(s)).

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:842aa4cce5d.label: 鲁棒控制系统设计目标
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:842aa4cce5d.description: The goal of robust control system design is to maintain acceptable closed-loop system performance in the presence of model inaccuracies and changes.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:875ce076812.label: 鲁棒稳定性判据
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:875ce076812.description: Equation (12.15) is called the robust stability criterion, a test for robustness with respect to a multiplicative perturbation.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:90cacda823e.label: 根灵敏度
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:90cacda823e.description: The root sensitivity is defined as the partial derivative of a root r_i with respect to the relative change in a parameter alpha.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:9a1d9d4a4af.label: 乘性摄动的性质
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:9a1d9d4a4af.description: The multiplicative perturbation form is often used because it is small at low frequencies where the nominal model is well known, and large at high frequencies where the nominal model is inexact.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:a6cb408c837.label: 加性摄动模型
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:a6cb408c837.description: The set of possible processes with additive perturbation is G_a(s)=G(s)+A(s).

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:ab88168f839.label: 模型不准确性的来源
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:ab88168f839.description: The process model can be inaccurate due to parameter changes, unmodeled dynamics, unmodeled time delays, changes in equilibrium point, sensor noise, and unpredicted disturbance inputs.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:ae382d12ece.label: 乘性摄动模型
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:ae382d12ece.description: The set of possible processes with multiplicative perturbation is G_m(s)=G(s)[1+M(s)].

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:c917b49a88e.label: 系统灵敏度
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:c917b49a88e.description: The system sensitivity is defined as the ratio of the relative change in the transfer function T to the relative change in a parameter alpha.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:cb54398b353.label: 鲁棒控制系统定义
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:cb54398b353.description: A control system is robust when it has low sensitivities, is stable over the expected range of parameter variations, and performance continues to meet specifications in the presence of a set of changes in system parameters.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:ec98e6bbda7.label: 小参数摄动的灵敏度鲁棒性度量
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:ec98e6bbda7.description: For small-parameter perturbations, differential sensitivities (system sensitivity and root sensitivity) may be used as a measure of robustness.

ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:ecde3cc6396.label: 控制目标
ctkg:m3-v2k:canonical-object:ecde3cc6396.description: The control objective is to design a compensator G_C(s) so that transient, steady-state, and frequency-domain specifications are achieved and the cost of feedback measured by the bandwidth of the compensator is sufficiently small.

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:1c127fa27aaa5a.label: 对G(s)的灵敏度
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:1c127fa27aaa5a.description: For the system with G(s)=1/s^2 and PD controller G_c(s)=K_p+K_D s, the sensitivity with respect to changes in G(s) is S_G^T = 1/(1+G_c(s)G(s)) = s^2/(s^2+K_D s+K_p).

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:223e3d608f2b32.label: 例12.3系统
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:223e3d608f2b32.description: The system in Example 12.3 has G_c=K and G(s)=170000(s+0.1)/(s(s+3)(s^2+10s+10000)).

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:367756d22f2546.label: 二阶系统
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:367756d22f2546.description: A closed-loop second-order system with plant transfer function K/(s(s+1)) and unity feedback, as shown in Figure 12.3.

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:400bdb4f5ad312.label: PD控制系统的闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:400bdb4f5ad312.description: The closed-loop transfer function for the PD-controlled system is T(s)=(K_D s+K_p)/(s^2+K_D s+K_p).

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:436c87085842f3.label: PD控制系统
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:436c87085842f3.description: A closed-loop system with plant G(s)=1/s^2 and PD controller G_c(s)=K_p+K_D s, as shown in Figure 12.6.

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:5d05ed1c91f353.label: 负单位阶跃输入的稳态误差
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:5d05ed1c91f353.description: The steady-state error due to a negative unit step input R(s)=-1/s for the system in Example 12.2 is e_ss=(1-2K)/(1-K).

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:5e6fc6b518531f.label: 灵敏度与补灵敏度伯德图
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:5e6fc6b518531f.description: A Bode magnitude plot showing 20 log|S| and 20 log|T| for the second-order system with K=1/4, illustrating the frequency regions where sensitivity or stability margin is important.

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:60559f2ace7bf8.label: 含不确定性的闭环控制系统
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:60559f2ace7bf8.description: A system structure that incorporates system uncertainties, including sensor noise N(s), disturbance input T_d(s), and a process G(s) with unmodeled dynamics or parameter changes.

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:65e23ca727760c.label: 一阶闭环系统示例
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:65e23ca727760c.description: A closed-loop first-order system with plant transfer function 1/(s+alpha) and unity feedback, as shown in Figure 12.2.

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:8d0c6470c62c14.label: 系统稳定增益范围
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:8d0c6470c62c14.description: The system in Example 12.2 is stable for a gain -2 < K < 1.

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:8dec43492b6bb5.label: 系统灵敏度
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:8dec43492b6bb5.description: The system sensitivity for K in the second-order system is S(s)=s(s+1)/(s^2+s+K).

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:91256c721d84a6.label: 含右半平面零点的闭环系统
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:91256c721d84a6.description: A closed-loop system with plant transfer function (s-1)/(s+1)^2 and gain K, as shown in Figure 12.8.

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:91efcf5f49211b.label: 滞后校正器
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:91efcf5f49211b.description: The lag compensator used is G_c(s)=0.15(s+25)/(s+2.5).

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:a434fdf0438d21.label: 二阶系统闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:a434fdf0438d21.description: The closed-loop transfer function of the second-order system in Figure 12.3 is T(s)=K/(s^2+s+K).

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:bfe6d16341b324.label: 不同增益下的阶跃响应图
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:bfe6d16341b324.description: A time-domain plot showing step responses for K=1, K=1/4, and K=1/16, illustrating the effect of gain variation on system robustness.

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:d6e50367ffbed9.label: 未建模极点对应的乘性摄动
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:d6e50367ffbed9.description: For an unmodeled pole at 50 rad/s, the multiplicative perturbation is determined from 1+M(s)=50/(s+50).

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:dedc9738595d9f.label: 一阶系统灵敏度
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:dedc9738595d9f.description: For the closed-loop system with T(s)=1/[s+(alpha+1)], the system sensitivity is -alpha/(s+alpha+1).

ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:f7550344c6b867.label: 含右半平面零点系统的闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2k:source-object:f7550344c6b867.description: For the system in Figure 12.8 with a right-hand-plane zero, the closed-loop transfer function is T(s)=K(s-1)/(s^2+(2+K)s+(1-K)).

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:04abc5818c5.label: 扰动影响最小化目标
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:04abc5818c5.description: Another important goal of a control system design is that the effect on the output of the system due to disturbances is minimized.

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:31e41f4057f.label: 带扰动的反馈控制系统
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:31e41f4057f.description: A feedback control system with desired input R(s), disturbance input T_d(s), controller G_c(s), plant G(s), and prefilter G_p(s).

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:719aca16350.label: 前置滤波器
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:719aca16350.description: A filter placed in the input path to shape the closed-loop transfer function, often to eliminate zeros.

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:7731e49138b.label: 最坏情况多项式
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:7731e49138b.description: One of the four polynomials represents the worst case and may indicate either unstable performance or at least the worst performance for the system in that case.

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:7b455f3e86e.label: 鲁棒控制设计目标
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:7b455f3e86e.description: The design seeks: 1. T(s) with wide bandwidth, 2. Large loop gain L(s) at low frequencies, 3. Small loop gain L(s) at high frequencies.

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:86942d2e923.label: Bode图频域指标
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:86942d2e923.description: For the Bode plot of G_c(jω)G(jω): 1. For relative stability, the loop gain must have not more than a -20-dB/decade slope at or near the crossover frequency ω_c. 2. Steady-state accuracy and measurement noise rejection achieved by the low gain at high frequency. 3. Disturbance rejection by a high ga

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:8754168bda2.label: ITAE设计步骤
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:8754168bda2.description: Three-step procedure to design PID coefficients using ITAE performance index and prefilter to eliminate zeros.

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:94708a97f75.label: ITAE性能指标
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:94708a97f75.description: Integral of time multiplied by absolute error, used as a performance index for control system design.

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:9f153ed8f3c.label: 降低根灵敏度与扰动影响的设计步骤
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:9f153ed8f3c.description: A three-step design procedure: 1. Sketch the root locus of the compensated system with G_c(s) chosen to attain the desired location for the dominant roots. 2. Maximize the gain of G_c(s) to reduce the effect of the disturbance. 3. Determine S_K^r and attain the minimum value of the root sensitivity

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:c1e442273a0.label: PID控制器
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:c1e442273a0.description: A controller with proportional, integral, and derivative terms, known for robust performance and simplicity.

ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:d230f157dfc.label: 跟踪误差最小化目标
ctkg:m3-v2l:canonical-object:d230f157dfc.description: One possible objective in the design of a control system is that the controlled system output should very accurately track the input, minimizing the tracking error.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:07986195da0b57.label: 闭环传递函数T(s)
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:07986195da0b57.description: The closed-loop transfer function from reference input R(s) to output Y(s) for the system in Figure 12.11.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:120b72cf2deb07.label: 三阶系统ITAE最优特征方程
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:120b72cf2deb07.description: Characteristic equation with optimum coefficients for ITAE performance for a third-order system.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:151a515793cb7b.label: PID控制器传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:151a515793cb7b.description: Transfer function of a PID controller with proportional, integral, and derivative terms.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:3663593e71d564.label: 根灵敏度
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:3663593e71d564.description: The sensitivity of a root r of the characteristic equation with respect to the gain K.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:4542bc9df696fd.label: 四个最坏情况多项式
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:4542bc9df696fd.description: The four polynomials that need to be investigated to determine stability for a third-order system with uncertain parameters.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:47135793ceff06.label: 闭环传递函数幅值（由Nichols图获得）
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:47135793ceff06.description: The magnitude of the closed-loop transfer function T(jω) as obtained from the Nichols chart.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:471c9775fec005.label: 三阶特征方程
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:471c9775fec005.description: The characteristic equation for a third-order system with uncertain parameters.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:57ff5557f55707.label: 大KD近似闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:57ff5557f55707.description: Approximate closed-loop transfer function when KD is large and Gp(s)=1.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:6b6581ea130fed.label: 不确定参数特征方程
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:6b6581ea130fed.description: The characteristic equation of a system with uncertain parameters, where coefficients are known within bounds.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:6faaa6a3c11dc8.label: PID控制器传递函数（因式分解形式）
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:6faaa6a3c11dc8.description: PID controller transfer function expressed as a ratio with a pole at origin and two zeros.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:7eb25adadb41b4.label: T(s)对G(s)的灵敏度
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:7eb25adadb41b4.description: The sensitivity of the closed-loop transfer function T(s) with respect to the plant G(s).

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:89665f26a72f66.label: 扰动传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:89665f26a72f66.description: The transfer function from disturbance T_d(s) to output Y(s) for the system in Figure 12.11.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:bd2dde5ba6fb1f.label: 系数界限
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:bd2dde5ba6fb1f.description: The bounds on the coefficients of the characteristic equation, with a_n = 1.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:c80184255f9dc4.label: 特征方程
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:c80184255f9dc4.description: The characteristic equation for the system in Figure 12.11, common to both reference and disturbance transfer functions.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:ebfa3aa64b2f40.label: 穿越频率处灵敏度
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:ebfa3aa64b2f40.description: The magnitude of the sensitivity function evaluated at the crossover frequency ω_c.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:ec3c4df3eaf64a.label: 灵敏度幅值（由闭环传递函数与回路增益计算）
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:ec3c4df3eaf64a.description: The sensitivity magnitude computed from the closed-loop transfer function and the loop gain at a frequency ω1 below ωc.

ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:f09f82fc152bdf.label: 含PID控制器的闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2l:source-object:f09f82fc152bdf.description: Closed-loop transfer function for a system with PID controller and plant, showing approximation when zeros cancel.

ctkg:m3-v2m:canonical-object:70e41328585.label: PID控制器引入一个原点极点和两个零点
ctkg:m3-v2m:canonical-object:70e41328585.description: A PID controller introduces a transfer function with one pole at the origin and two zeros.

ctkg:m3-v2m:canonical-object:a3b6575807b.label: PID参数难以直接映射到性能
ctkg:m3-v2m:canonical-object:a3b6575807b.description: The main problem in selecting PID parameters is that these coefficients do not readily translate into desired performance and robustness characteristics.

ctkg:m3-v2m:canonical-object:bf8187368ce.label: 三阶无差拍系统2%调节时间
ctkg:m3-v2m:canonical-object:bf8187368ce.description: For the third-order deadbeat transfer function, the settling time (with a 2% criterion) is Ts = 4/ωn.

ctkg:m3-v2m:canonical-object:ed14fe8a69d.label: PID控制器在降低稳态误差和改善瞬态响应中的效用
ctkg:m3-v2m:canonical-object:ed14fe8a69d.description: PID controllers are particularly useful for reducing steady-state error and improving transient response when G(s) has one or two poles or can be approximated by a second-order process.

ctkg:m3-v2m:canonical-object:ed9e310c836.label: 内模原理
ctkg:m3-v2m:canonical-object:ed9e310c836.description: If Gc(s)G(s) contains R(s), then Y(s) will track R(s) asymptotically in the steady state, and the tracking is robust.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:01da79739fa05a.label: 根灵敏度表达式
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:01da79739fa05a.description: The root sensitivity S_K^r evaluated for the example system, derived from the characteristic equation.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:1705e6ba04d3c3.label: 灵敏度函数幅值
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:1705e6ba04d3c3.description: The magnitude of the sensitivity function S_G^T at a frequency ω1 below ω_c, expressed as the ratio of |T| to |G_c G|.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:31f18ac5c4d3f3.label: PI控制开环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:31f18ac5c4d3f3.description: The product of the PI controller and plant transfer function for a system with G(s)=1/s, given by (Kp + KI/s)(1/s) = (Kp s + KI)/s^2.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:42717b068cafb8.label: PID控制下温度控制闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:42717b068cafb8.description: Closed-loop transfer function for the temperature control example with PID controller and Gp(s)=1.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:5b46bb6ad05d3b.label: 温度控制对象传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:5b46bb6ad05d3b.description: Plant transfer function for the temperature control example.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:6f24469a649646.label: 示例系统特征方程
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:6f24469a649646.description: The characteristic equation for the example system with G_c(s)=K and G(s)=1/(s(s+1)).

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:86995273f5e35a.label: 灵敏度幅值计算
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:86995273f5e35a.description: The numerical calculation of the sensitivity magnitude at ω1=2 for the compensated system in Example 12.6.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:8c76f7e548ed2a.label: 超前校正器传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:8c76f7e548ed2a.description: The compensator transfer function chosen in Example 12.6, a lead compensator with gain K, zero at -z, and pole at -p.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:986a0736dc2b06.label: 鲁棒设计方法
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:986a0736dc2b06.description: One design approach is to design the control for the worst-case condition; another approach is to design for the nominal G(s) and one-half the desired settling time.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:98f12df04fdd8c.label: 复根时根灵敏度幅值
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:98f12df04fdd8c.description: The magnitude of the root sensitivity when ζ<1 and roots are complex, for the example system.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:9d4f09cc74fe32.label: 大KD近似闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:9d4f09cc74fe32.description: Approximate closed-loop transfer function when KD is much greater than 1, with Gp(s)=1.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:cc073dec30c5e4.label: 预滤波器传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:cc073dec30c5e4.description: Prefilter transfer function used to eliminate zeros in the closed-loop transfer function.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:d2ff15d8474e2e.label: 被控对象传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:d2ff15d8474e2e.description: Plant transfer function with gain K and time constant tau, used to investigate robustness.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:e2f7eea06f8edf.label: 含PID控制器的闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:e2f7eea06f8edf.description: Closed-loop transfer function for a system with PID controller, showing cancellation of zeros and complex roots.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:e3b67218bef472.label: 带前置滤波器的闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:e3b67218bef472.description: Closed-loop transfer function with prefilter to achieve desired ITAE response, eliminating zeros.

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:eb918bc22f5fb0.label: 状态反馈内模控制闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:eb918bc22f5fb0.description: The closed-loop transfer function of the system in Figure 12.20 with appropriate Gp(s), given by T(s) = KI/(s^3 + (3+KD+Kb)s^2 + (2+KP+Ka+2Kb)s + KI).

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:f25f3ed672ccb5.label: PI控制闭环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:f25f3ed672ccb5.description: The closed-loop transfer function T(s) for the system with PI controller and plant 1/s, given by (Kp s + KI)/(s^2 + Kp s + KI).

ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:f6b369c71fc216.label: 最坏情况被控对象传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2m:source-object:f6b369c71fc216.description: The worst-case plant transfer function when the two poles of G(s) change by ±50%, given by Ĝ(s) = 1/((s+0.5)(s+1)).

ctkg:m3-v2p:canonical-object:64f6e66a201.label: 相交时自振稳定性判据
ctkg:m3-v2p:canonical-object:64f6e66a201.description: 当G(jω)曲线与负倒描述函数曲线相交时，若负倒描述函数沿振幅增加方向由不稳定区域进入稳定区域，则自振稳定；反之不稳定。自振振幅由交点处负倒描述函数确定，频率由G曲线确定。

ctkg:m3-v2p:canonical-object:c036e4246a4.label: 不相交时非线性系统稳定性判据
ctkg:m3-v2p:canonical-object:c036e4246a4.description: 当G(jω)曲线与负倒描述函数曲线不相交时，若G曲线不包围负倒描述函数曲线则系统稳定，否则不稳定。

ctkg:m3-v2r:canonical-object:04e480f9a07.label: 闭环特征方程
ctkg:m3-v2r:canonical-object:04e480f9a07.description: The characteristic equation of the closed-loop system is obtained by setting the denominator of the closed-loop transfer function to zero.

ctkg:m3-v2r:canonical-object:37f52a59ccd.label: 补灵敏度函数
ctkg:m3-v2r:canonical-object:37f52a59ccd.description: The complementary sensitivity function, defined as the closed-loop transfer function, equal to one minus the sensitivity function.

ctkg:m3-v2r:canonical-object:43796246fc4.label: 反馈稳定性特征方程
ctkg:m3-v2r:canonical-object:43796246fc4.description: For the feedback system, the system poles are the roots of the characteristic equation 1 + G D_cl = 0.

ctkg:m3-v2r:canonical-object:98500b6c260.label: 开环传递函数
ctkg:m3-v2r:canonical-object:98500b6c260.description: The open-loop transfer function is the product of the plant transfer function and the open-loop controller transfer function.

ctkg:m3-v2r:canonical-object:9ac16bf52d9.label: 开环稳定性要求
ctkg:m3-v2r:canonical-object:9ac16bf52d9.description: For open-loop stability, neither the plant denominator polynomial nor the controller denominator polynomial may have roots in the right half-plane.

ctkg:m3-v2r:source-object:54af3b5421c490.label: 闭环输出方程
ctkg:m3-v2r:source-object:54af3b5421c490.description: The output of the closed-loop system is the superposition of responses to reference, plant disturbance, and sensor noise.

ctkg:m3-v2r:source-object:b23b6c99d0eae7.label: 闭环控制方程
ctkg:m3-v2r:source-object:b23b6c99d0eae7.description: The control signal in the closed-loop system is the superposition of responses to reference, plant disturbance, and sensor noise.

ctkg:m3-v2s:canonical-object:7febaf558a5.label: 乘性不确定性表示
ctkg:m3-v2s:canonical-object:7febaf558a5.description: The representation of the uncertain time delay as a multiplicative uncertainty, where Gm(s) = (1+M(s))G(s) and M(s) = e^{-Ts}-1.

ctkg:m3-v2s:canonical-object:961ae2a6714.label: 小增益定理鲁棒稳定性条件
ctkg:m3-v2s:canonical-object:961ae2a6714.description: The closed-loop system is stable if the magnitude of the multiplicative uncertainty M(jω) is less than the magnitude of 1 + 1/(Gc(jω)G(jω)) for all frequencies.

ctkg:m3-v2s:source-object:31791c09a15222.label: 时延稳定鲁棒性条件
ctkg:m3-v2s:source-object:31791c09a15222.description: Condition for stability robustness to time delay: |W(jω)| < |1 + 1/(G_c(jω)G(jω))| for all ω.

ctkg:m3-v2u:source-object:882fe815e14515.label: 有界时延不确定性
ctkg:m3-v2u:source-object:882fe815e14515.description: The exact value of the time delay is uncertain, but is known to lie in the interval $T_{1} \leq T \leq T_{2}$.

ctkg:m3-v2u:source-object:6b70b8e5aa2f73.label: M 与 W 的严格幅值不等式

ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:c76b72fc8788bc.label: 用于拉普拉斯逆变换的图解留数求值
ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:c76b72fc8788bc.description: The inverse Laplace transform can be evaluated using graphical residue evaluation.

ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:bdffd10d360f49.label: 绝对指数可积条件
ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:bdffd10d360f49.description:
Source-stated transformability condition:

$$
\int_{0^{-}}^{\infty}|f(t)| e^{-\sigma_{1} t} d t<\infty
$$

ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:d7427d33be636d.label: 终值定理的极点限制
ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:d7427d33be636d.description: For the final-value theorem stated in the source, a simple pole of $Y(s)$ at the origin is permitted, but poles on the imaginary axis and in the right half-plane, and repeated poles at the origin, are excluded.

ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:360e9849be9b86.label: 源弹簧-质量-阻尼参数化的欠阻尼特征根
ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:360e9849be9b86.description: In the source spring-mass-damper parameterization, when $\zeta<1$, the response is underdamped and the characteristic roots are:

ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:a794163da23e6c.label: 线性微分方程的可变换充分条件
ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:a794163da23e6c.description:
The Laplace transform exists for linear differential equations for which the transformation integral converges. Therefore, for $f(t)$ to be transformable, it is sufficient that

$$
\int_{0^{-}}^{\infty}|f(t)| e^{-\sigma_{1} t} d t<\infty
$$

with sigma_1 real and positive.

ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:2107b134aa2e94.label: 用于拉普拉斯逆变换的 Heaviside 部分分式展开
ctkg:m3-v2w:source-object:2107b134aa2e94.description: The inverse Laplace transformation is usually obtained by using the Heaviside partial fraction expansion. This approach is particularly useful for systems analysis and design because the effect of each characteristic root or eigenvalue can be clearly observed.
